note: Spot-expression variations of the six free_kraken PF sleeves, rostered live beside their parents under the owner's variation doctrine (a form that needs a different expression becomes an ADDITIONAL sleeve variation with its own id, falsifier and grade path; the original is never edited into its variation) and the no-shadow ruling (variations roster live). Executes the registered question CAND-CTB-SPOT-ADA/LINK (midna-book/strategy-candidates/2026-11-14-ctb-spot-ada-expression.md and 2026-11-14-ctb-spot-link-expression.md). The six parents (free_kraken_ada_basis, free_kraken_ada_breakdown, free_kraken_ada_crowded, free_kraken_link_basis, free_kraken_link_breakdown, free_kraken_link_crowded) are byte-untouched and keep failing closed by name at the PF_ seam (INTENT-RECORDED-UNLISTED-20261116). Signal sources are the parents' own readings, unchanged: the KrakenProducer perp-vs-spot basis series (basis sleeves), the breakdown construction on the served spot 4h tape (breakdown sleeves), and that construction plus the PF funding gate read from the same kraken.funding PF series (crowded sleeves — the funding input is PF-market information, retained as a conditioner and named, never dropped or proxied). Registered expression rule (both candidate files): Alpaca serves no crypto spot shorting, so the short side is a named no-trade, never a fabricated short; the spot leg trades only the direction spot can lawfully take (basis: long spot on a perp discount beyond the parent's 25bps band, exit at the -5bps mirror normalization or the parent's 16h hold).
source: Desk full audit escalation 3 (FULL-AUDIT-FIX-2026-11-16.md); owner ruling 2026-11-16 09:22 ET: 'Fix them you should know what I want'; registered candidates CAND-CTB-SPOT-ADA and CAND-CTB-SPOT-LINK (2026-11-14).

variations.falsifier: Over the first 40 registered signal events (or two calendar months, whichever completes first), the spot expression's per-event expectancy net of Alpaca crypto fees and spread is not positive, or the spot leg's realized convergence captures less than half the perpetual reading's move over the hold window (in which case the basis lives in the perp's funding / positioning, not in spot, and the candidate is killed, not loosened).
variations.form: Parent basis signal unchanged (basis_bps on the newest completed aligned 4h perp-vs-spot pair, parent's basis_decision on the KrakenProducer series served under the parent's kraken_inputs key). Traded instrument ADA/USD spot. LONG 1 ADA/USD when basis_bps <= -25 (perp discount beyond the parent's band) with a fresh spot-tape reference; exit when basis_bps >= -5 or after 16h. The parent's own entry condition (premium >= +25bps, short side) is a named no-trade in spot (spot_decision status named_no_trade_premium_side). Pricing at the served spot tape's newest close (no spot quote is served for ADA/USD; the PF quote is a futures ticker and is not used to price spot).
variations.grade_path: Graded from the dispatcher record at B5: this sleeve's own ADA/USD spot entries/exits are live broker fills; per-event expectancy net of Alpaca crypto fees and spread over the hold window; convergence capture measured against the parent sleeve's basis reading over the same window. Premium-side named no-trades count as registered signal events, reconstructed deterministically from the served basis series by the pinned spot_decision function (tests/test_pf_spot_variations_20261116_blockers.py).
variations.kill_rule: Non-positive per-event expectancy over the first 40 registered signal events (or two calendar months), or realized convergence under half the perpetual reading's move, retires the variation; the parent is untouched either way.
variations.status: ROSTERED LIVE 2026-11-16 (PF-SPOT-VARIATIONS-20261116); forward accrual from rostering.

variations.falsifier: Over the first 40 registered signal events (or two calendar months, whichever completes first), the paired relative-value expression's per-event spread expectancy is not positive: per event, BTC/USD's return over the parent's 16h holding window minus the signal asset's (ADA/USD spot) return over the same window, net of Alpaca crypto fees and spread under the desk's crypto fee convention (10bp per side on the traded BTC leg (desk3/aster_crypto.py FEE=0.001; desk3/t474u_crypto.py FEE_1X_CRYPTO=0.001; aster_sleeves/_common.py FEE = Decimal("0.001"), 10 bps each side, crypto_rules.json)). Non-positive spread expectancy kills the variation, killed, not loosened.
variations.form: Parent breakdown construction unchanged (parent's breakdown_decision: signal close below the prior 20 bars' low on completed 4h bars, entry due at open(i+2), 16h hold clock), computed on the served ADA/USD spot 4h tape instead of PF_ADAUSD bars. The side is short and Alpaca serves no crypto spot shorting, so an entry_ready decision is a named no-trade (spot_decision status named_no_trade_short_side, parent's event id carried). The parent's ENH breakdown-validity gate prices a short fill and has no spot object; it is named not carried in the strategy docstring. AMENDMENT (MAKE-IT-WORK Decision C, PF-PAIRED-RV-20261116; owner ruling 2026-11-16 12:46 ET, 'Make it work'): the registered trade form is now the PAIRED RELATIVE-VALUE expression of the same unchanged signal: when entry_ready fires, the sleeve enters LONG BTC/USD spot (Alpaca-listed, the desk's existing route) at the same due time the short would have entered, sized by the sleeve's own slice (fractional qty = slice cash net of the per-side fee over the BTC price, gated by the dispatcher's normal slice check), held for the parent's 16h hold clock, then exits the full held BTC quantity through the normal intent path. If the anchor leg cannot be entered (BTC/USD served tape stale under the sleeves' freshness discipline, or the slice check sizes/refuses it), the sleeve fails closed with a named abstention (named_abstention_anchor_stale / named_abstention_slice), never a forced trade and never a fabricated short. The pure-short form described above is RETAINED in this record as the named future-venue form: it becomes the trade form only on a venue serving crypto spot shorting that the owner authorizes; it is not deleted.
